name: Tornado Chilli Khalbali
ingredients: CORN MEAL (63%), EDIBLE VEGETABLE OIL (LUNTAINS ONE OR MORE FOLLOWINGS: PALMOLEIN, RICE BRAN, CORN, COTTONSEED), **SEASONING (EDIBLE COMMON SALT, SUGAR, MALTODEXTRIN, DEHYDRATED VEGETABLE POWDER (ONION GARLIC, TOMATO), CHILLI POWDER (0.6%), HYDROLYZED VEGETABLE PROTEIN (SOYA), FLAVOUR (NATURAL & NATURE IDENTICAL FLAVOURING SUBSTANCES), STABILIZER (INS 170 (1)), ANTICAKING AGENT (INS 551), EMULSIFIER (INS 471, INS 470), MILK SOLIDS (0.1%), PAPRIKA EXTRACT (INS 160C), FLAVOUR ENHANCER (INS 627, INS 631, INS 621), ACIDITY REGULATOR (INS 330, INS 296, INS 334)].
